component.name: Apedi
component.summary: Fast, simple text editor with projects and terminal

description.p: Apedi is a lightweight GTK 4 / GtkSourceView 5 editor with bundled code formatters, multi-project sidebar, integrated terminal, and the small set of IDE conveniences a polyglot developer reaches for daily.
Features:

ul.li: Code formatting (Ctrl+Shift+I) via bundled black, prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, clang-format, shfmt
Multi-project sidebar with .gitignore awareness, per-extension icons and colors
Quick Open (Ctrl+P), Find in Files (Ctrl+Shift+F), Go to Symbol (Ctrl+M)
Integrated VTE terminal with bash and zsh (Ctrl+`)
Optional autosave, crash recovery, external-change watcher
Auto / light / dark theme; localized UI (English, Polski)

description.p: Vue and Svelte files get syntax highlighting (HTML fallback). Find in Files has a new project switcher (defaults to the sidebar-selected project). AppStream icon reference switched to type="local" so Ubuntu Software / GNOME Software can resolve it.
Snap ships app icons at all standard hicolor sizes so Ubuntu Software / GNOME Software can display them; the store icon is now a proper 512x512.

Markdown preview: real tables (bordered GtkGrid with header, zebra, alignment), code blocks as full-width bordered rectangles, task lists rendered as ☑ / ☐, h1/h2 get an underline, nested blockquotes show one prefix bar per depth. Renderer refactored to a block-level pipeline: HTML → dataclass Blocks → per-block widgets.
New, more colorful application icon. Ko-fi and buycoffee.to support links in the ☕ menu and About dialog.
Startup performance: snap install shrinks from ~1.1 GB to ~580 MB, faster cold launches, WebKit removed in favor of Pango-based markdown preview, lazier imports, fast apedi --version.
Markdown preview: split-view live rendering for .md files with theme-aware styling, Ctrl+Shift+M toggle, auto-open switch in Preferences.
Find/Replace in Files is now modal and centered. Pre-fills the search input from the current selection.
Fix New File… / New Folder… crash in the sidebar context menu (gettext alias shadowed by *_ parameter). Input prompt window centered as a proper dialog.
Fix sidebar right-click menu items doing nothing — replaced PopoverMenu + Gio.Menu with a plain Popover so actions fire.
Sidebar collapse button, multiple terminals, sidebar right-click context menu (New File / New Folder / Find / Replace / Replace with), Replace in Files mode, new keyboard shortcuts.
What's New dialog renders CHANGELOG bold, ## headings and Markdown bullet lists properly.

Header bar reshuffled with a ☕ button on the right. Keyboard Shortcuts window (Ctrl+?). Compact sidebar now the default. Quick Open / Find in Files fall back to open-tab folders when no project is loaded. Terminal picks the user's zsh correctly.
Quick Open, Find in Files, integrated About, snippets, crash recovery, file watcher, expanded keyboard cheat-sheet.
Multiple open projects in the sidebar.
Tabbed Preferences, internationalization (Polish), autosave, file-manager registration toggle.
Gitignore-aware sidebar, ignore patterns, compact mode, symbol palette.
Project sidebar, What's New dialog, Replace on Ctrl+R, integrated terminal.
Preferences dialog, dark mode, snap startup fixes.
Initial release.
